scope: Current Elite Dangerous carrier-ship compatibility for the Rhino SRV and Ship-Launched Fighters, including compatible hulls, Fighter Hangar class ranges, and practical Type-11 notes used by Ask the Mongrels and the Reference Database.

entries.topic: Which Ships Can Carry the Rhino?
entries.ruleOfThumb: The Rhino uses a Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar and is currently supported by 13 medium/large hulls. The Type-11 Prospector is compatible, so a Type-11 can carry and deploy a Rhino.

quickFacts.label: Same hull set as SLF Fighter Hangar

details: Do not confuse the Rhino hangar with the ordinary Planetary Vehicle Hangar used by Scarab and Scorpion SRVs.
Do not confuse it with the Fighter Hangar/Vessel Hangar used by Ship-Launched Fighters and ship-launched vessels. The Rhino uses its own Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar module family.
The published compatible-hull set matches the current Fighter Hangar-compatible hull set, which is a useful shortcut when checking whether a ship can serve as a Rhino carrier.
The compatible internal-class range varies by ship; use the table below when planning a build.
commonMistakes: Assuming every ship that can carry a Scarab or Scorpion can also carry the Rhino.
Looking for the Rhino under a normal Planetary Vehicle Hangar instead of the Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar.
Assuming the Type-11 cannot carry a Rhino because it already has a dedicated Fighter Hangar compartment. The Rhino uses a separate compatible internal.
entries.operations: For Rhino mining, choose one of the compatible hulls, fit a Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar within the supported class range, carry enough ship cargo space to receive refined ore from the Rhino, and fit a DSS for locating Planetary Mining Locations.

entries.topic: Which Ships Can Carry an SLF?
keywords: which ships can fit fighter hangar
entries.ruleOfThumb: Only specific hulls can equip a Fighter Hangar. The current list contains 13 ships, including the Type-11 Prospector, which has a dedicated Class 5 Fighter Hangar compartment.

quickFacts.label: Type-11 Prospector
quickFacts.value: Yes — dedicated Class 5 Fighter Hangar slot

details: A Fighter Hangar carries Ship-Launched Fighters and manufactures replacements after fighters are destroyed; the fighter craft itself is purchased separately.
Class 5 Fighter Hangars have one fighter bay and six fighter replacements. Class 6 hangars have two bays with eight fighters per bay. Class 7 hangars have two bays with fifteen fighters per bay.
Two simultaneously active player-controlled SLFs require an appropriate two-bay Class 6 or Class 7 hangar and a compatible multicrew arrangement.
An SLF cannot enter supercruise or hyperspace independently; it operates locally around its mothership.
The Type-11 Prospector is unusual because one of its reserved Class 5 internal compartments is specifically dedicated to a Fighter Hangar.
commonMistakes: Assuming any multicrew-capable ship can fit a Fighter Hangar. Fighter Hangar compatibility is hull-specific.
Using an old SLF ship list that omits newer compatible hulls such as the Caspian Explorer, Panther Clipper Mk II, and Type-11 Prospector.
Assuming a Class 5 hangar can field two fighter loadouts at once; Class 5 has only one bay.
entries.pve: SLFs are useful for adding pressure, distraction and an NPC or human wingman to combat-capable motherships.
entries.pvp: The Mongrels permit SLFs generally but strongly discourage them in PvP because fighter synchronization/lag can degrade the fight for other players.
